google_account: demo login identity (the presenter); unchanged from the existing datasets
auth_roles: the four persona roles the app already defines; access notes written for Ironbridge Environmental Services
credentials: one handle per warehouse source (ironbridge_ops, ironbridge_fin, ironbridge_legacy); deterministic
projects: gen/gen_graph_waste.py - 3 warehouse sources, 3 datasets, 22 tables; row counts are the invented warehouse’s
audit: authored for the demo fortnight (23 October to 3 November 2026)
traces: sealed traces over recorded answers; stats computed from them
evals: computed from ask_answers, the review queue and the sanity checks
change_signals: the graph’s own gaps - what the data cannot support, with the do-not clause
column_profiles: every column of the 22 tables, with profiler statistics; the dictionaries in uploads/05_data_catalog carry the same columns
document_vocabulary: the document-corpus profile of the Google Drive source
drives: the Technical Solutions folder in Google Drive: 6 folders, 31 documents; page, character and chunk counts measured from the rendered files in drive_corpus/
document_extractions: _build/extractions_waste.py - what the document graph builder reads from each document, resolved to canvas node ids
graph_domains: domains ranked by what the connected data supports
graph_studio: _build/graph_waste.py canvas (concepts, thin instances, measures; spring layout) + 8 review items with 1 pivot + 5 sanity checks
graph_personas: the personas of the Waste Stream Analyst role; top_questions are the hero ids each one asks
graph_hero_questions: every question the Ask answers carry (HQ1 to HQ45)
graph_answer_formats: the block mixes the answers use
graph_use_cases: the one committed role - Waste Stream Analyst for Ironbridge Environmental Services
ask_answers: _build/answers_waste.py - 49 recorded answers (HQ1 to HQ45 and four extra declines Q46 to Q49); every figure computed from the datasets
reports: _build/gov_waste.py - three reports and their governance; Reports is hidden from the sidebar for every persona, but governance feeds Audit & Governance
settings: the eight demo users (all on the demo login domain) and the nav permissions the app uses today (Reports hidden)
reports_prototype: the Authoring tab fixture - the twelve generators with the most revenue January to September, with their margin on full cost, in USD millions
data_model: declared relationships between the tables, confirmed by the presenter, plus open suggestions
graph_metrics: the governed measures of the Waste Stream Analyst role
studio_graph: the as-built graph-version shape: structured lane over the selected tables, document lane extracted from the corpus, Bridge type links
